choices.text: Randomized experiments estimate intervention effects when assignment and exposure are controlled.
A model can abstain on uncertain cases, trading coverage for improved accuracy on accepted predictions.
Privacy mechanisms limit information disclosed about training examples, with a measurable utility and privacy trade-off.
Temporal validation estimates future-facing performance when data and relationships evolve over time.
